title: Hampta Pass with Chandratal
tagline: Cross from green Kullu into the stark desert of Lahaul

images.alt: Trekkers walking through the green meadows of Hampta valley
The crescent-shaped Chandratal lake beneath snow peaks
A trekker standing on a rocky ridge facing snow-capped peaks
Snow-covered valley with a frozen stream
Tents pitched at a misty alpine campsite

description: Hampta Pass is one of the most dramatic crossover treks in India. In just a few days you walk from the lush, pine-forested valleys of Kullu over a 14,100 ft pass and descend into the barren, moon-like landscape of Lahaul. We finish with a drive to Chandratal — the ‘Moon Lake’ — whose colours shift from turquoise to deep blue through the day. It's the perfect first high-altitude trek: challenging enough to feel earned, gentle enough for fit beginners.
highlights: Dramatic crossover from green Kullu to desert Lahaul
Camp beside the Rani Nallah under a sky full of stars
Sunset at the crescent-shaped Chandratal lake
River crossings and glacier views at Shea Goru
Ideal first high-altitude trek for fit beginners

itinerary.title: Manali to Jobra, trek to Chika
itinerary.description: Drive from Manali to Jobra through 40+ hairpin bends. A gentle 2-hour walk through maple and pine forests brings you to our riverside camp at Chika.

itinerary.title: Chika to Balu ka Ghera
itinerary.description: Walk along the Rani Nallah with the Dhauladhar peaks slowly revealing themselves. Cross the river and reach Balu ka Ghera, a wide sandy campsite beneath the pass.

itinerary.title: Cross Hampta Pass to Shea Goru
itinerary.description: The big day. A steady climb brings you to the top of Hampta Pass for sweeping views of Lahaul's Indrasan and Deo Tibba. Descend steeply to Shea Goru.

itinerary.title: Shea Goru to Chatru, drive to Chandratal
itinerary.description: A short walk to Chatru, then drive along the Chandra river to Chandratal. Spend the evening by the lake as the colours change with the light.

itinerary.title: Chandratal to Manali
itinerary.description: Sunrise at the lake, then drive back to Manali.

title: Sar Pass Trek
tagline: Snow slides, pine forests and the Parvati valley

images.alt: A trekker walking along a snowy ridge towards Sar Pass
Snow peaks rising above a sea of clouds
Trekkers gathered around a campfire in the forest
A sharp snowy peak at golden hour
Silhouettes of trekkers on snow at sunset

description: Sar Pass begins in the backpacker village of Kasol and climbs through dense pine and oak forests to Grahan village, before opening up onto snowfields with sweeping views of the Parvati valley. The highlight is the famous snow slide on the descent from the pass — a memory every Sar Pass trekker carries home.
highlights: Slide down a natural snow chute from the pass
Stay in the remote village of Grahan
Sunrise views from Min Thach and Nagaru
Walk through rhododendron and pine forests

itinerary.title: Kasol to Grahan village
itinerary.description: Trek along the Grahan Nallah through thick forest to the ancient village of Grahan.

itinerary.title: Grahan to Min Thach
itinerary.description: A steep climb through rhododendron forest opens up to the grassy meadow of Min Thach.

itinerary.title: Min Thach to Nagaru
itinerary.description: Climb onto the snowline to Nagaru, the highest campsite, with 360° views of the Parvati valley.

itinerary.title: Nagaru – Sar Pass – Biskeri Thach
itinerary.description: Early start to cross Sar Pass, followed by the snow slide descent to the meadows of Biskeri.

itinerary.title: Biskeri to Barshaini, drive to Kasol
itinerary.description: Descend via Bandak Thach to Barshaini and drive back to Kasol.

title: Deoriatal Chandrashila
tagline: A mirror lake, rhododendron forests and a 360° summit

images.alt: Snow peaks reflected in the still waters of Deoriatal
Sunrise over the Garhwal Himalaya from Chandrashila summit
Himalayan peaks glowing pink at dusk
View of mountains from inside a tent

description: This trek combines two of Garhwal's finest experiences: the emerald Deoriatal lake, where Chaukhamba's peaks reflect on still mornings, and the summit of Chandrashila, which offers one of the widest Himalayan panoramas you can reach on foot — Nanda Devi, Trishul, Kedarnath and Chaukhamba all in one frame.
highlights: Chaukhamba reflected in Deoriatal at sunrise
Summit Chandrashila for a 360° Himalayan panorama
Visit Tungnath, the highest Shiva temple in the world

title: Har Ki Dun Trek
tagline: The ‘Valley of Gods’ and its 3,000-year-old villages

images.alt: A pine-lined valley leading towards snow-capped peaks
A group of trekkers outside a traditional wooden homestay
Mist rolling through a Himalayan valley

description: Har Ki Dun is a cradle-shaped valley at the foot of Swargarohini, the mythical stairway to heaven. The trail winds through ancient villages with intricately carved wooden houses, dense forests of pine and walnut, and finally opens onto meadows ringed by snow peaks.
highlights: Views of Swargarohini and Black Peak
Stay in the 3,000-year-old village of Osla
Excellent for photography and culture lovers

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri

itinerary.title: Sankri to Pauni Garaat

itinerary.title: Pauni Garaat to Kalkatiyadhar

itinerary.title: Explore Har Ki Dun valley
itinerary.description: Trek to the valley floor with Swargarohini views, explore Maninda Tal and return.

itinerary.title: Kalkatiyadhar to Sankri
itinerary.description: Retrace the trail to Taluka and drive to Sankri.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Dehradun
itinerary.description: Drive back to Dehradun.
